summary.text: Bill Bell is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 8, which covers Doddridge, Tyler and Wetzel counties.
He is a fifth grade teacher and serves on the Education and Public Education committees.

paragraphs.text: Bell was born in Parkersburg, West Virginia, on April 18, 1987.

His page lists a B.A. in elementary education from WVU Parkersburg, a postgraduate certificate in school principalship from Marshall University, and master's degrees from Western Governors University and Ashland University.

His affiliations include president of the Paden City Lions Club, Paden City Council member from 2021 to 2025, the 2025 West Virginia History Teacher of the Year, the Wetzel County Republican Executive Committee and the National Rifle Association.
His interim committees are Education, the Forest Management Review Commission, and Volunteer Fire Departments and Emergency Medical Services.
